# `sourcetensor`

the band cross-spectral tensor of the current at every source, its Stokes parameters, its normal power and normal share.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run sourcetensor --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run sourcetensor --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run sourcetensor --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --all [--kernel NAME]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel"} | yes |
| `surface` | manifold surface, is kernel.to | yes |
| `frames` | field canonical frames, manifold kernel.to (the canonical frames of the kernel's surface (`nxr-neuro run frames` first)) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the free-orientation inverse kernel's name, or none: the subject's one inverse kernel on the recording's channels |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_{kernel}_tensor` | - |  | the stem of the stored statistics: <name>, <name>_stokes, <name>_normalpower, <name>_normalshare; their segment partition <name>_segments |
| `bands` | `--bands` | `[{"name": "delta", "lo": 2, "hi": 4}, {"name": "theta", "lo": 5, "hi": 7}, {"name": "alpha", "lo": 8, "hi": 12}, {"name": "beta", "lo": 15, "hi": 29}, {"name": "gamma1", "lo": 30, "hi": 59}, {"name": "gamma2", "lo": 60, "hi": 90}]` | Hz |  | the bands: {name, lo, hi}; a band holds the bins from lo to hi inclusive (Brainstorm's default bands) |
| `segment_seconds` | `--segment-seconds` | `4.0` | s |  | the segment's length in seconds (under segment_rule tile it snaps to the nearest 2^k samples) |
| `segment_samples` | `--segment-samples` | none | samples |  | the segment's length in samples (wins over segment_seconds); null: from segment_seconds |
| `segment_rule` | `--segment-rule` | `tile` | - | tile, round, even | how the segment's length becomes samples: tile \| round \| even |
| `overlap` | `--overlap` | `0.5` | fraction |  | the fraction of a segment shared with the next, in [0, 1) |
| `window` | `--window` | `hamming` | - | hann, hamming, blackman, rectangular | the taper of each segment |
| `periodic` | `--periodic` | false | - |  | the DFT-even form of the window rather than the symmetric one |
| `detrend` | `--detrend` | `constant` | - | none, constant, linear | what is removed from each segment before windowing |
| `scaling` | `--scaling` | `density` | - | density, spectrum, chain | density = power per Hz \| spectrum = power \| chain = per sample, per bin |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - | exclude, ignore | exclude = a segment touching one of the recording's bad segments is left out \| ignore = every segment is kept |

## Presets

`--set <preset>` sets the parameters below at once; a parameter given by name wins over the preset.

| preset | sets |
|---|---|
| `tiles` | segment_rule=tile |
| `brainstorm` | segment_rule=round, window=hamming, periodic=false, detrend=constant, scaling=density |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.source_tensor`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, kernel=kernel, frames=frames, surface=surface, exclude=bad | bands=$bands, segment_seconds=$segment_seconds, segment_samples=$segment_samples, segment_rule=$segment_rule, overlap=$overlap, window=$window, periodic=$periodic, detrend=$detrend, scaling=$scaling, bad_segments=$bad_segments | tensor, stokes, normal_power, normal_share |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `tensor` | kind statistic, name $name, of recording, axes [{"name": "vertex", "on": "kernel.to"}, {"name": "band"}], partition {"tiling": "$name_segments", "on": "recording.time"} |
| `stokes` | kind statistic, name $name_stokes, of recording, axes [{"name": "vertex", "on": "kernel.to"}, {"name": "band"}], partition {"tiling": "$name_segments", "on": "recording.time"} |
| `normal_power` | kind statistic, name $name_normalpower, of recording, axes [{"name": "vertex", "on": "kernel.to"}, {"name": "band"}], partition {"tiling": "$name_segments", "on": "recording.time"} |
| `normal_share` | kind statistic, name $name_normalshare, of recording, axes [{"name": "vertex", "on": "kernel.to"}, {"name": "band"}], partition {"tiling": "$name_segments", "on": "recording.time"} |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE BAND CROSS-SPECTRAL TENSOR OF THE CURRENT (four statistics): the channels' cross-spectrum and quadrature per band (Welch, streamed chunk by chunk, the recording's bad
segments left out), then T = K_v S K_v^H at every source through a FREE-orientation inverse kernel (3 x 3 Hermitian, the kernel's x y z); from it the tangential Stokes
parameters in the canonical frames of the kernel's surface, the power along the normal (the frames' n, the area-weighted mesh normal where they are singular) and its share
of the trace. The tensor is the kernel's estimate: a minimum-norm kernel spreads each source over its neighbours, and resolves orientations only as far as it resolves them.

  nxr-neuro run sourcetensor --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --all [--kernel NAME]
```
